issue.title: Why does the weekly summary show more transactions than my report?
issue.body:
This Monday's summary email said "EUR: 212 transactions" for last week, but our
"Operating account" report for the same seven days lists 140. Nothing looks
wrong in the report itself. Which transactions does the weekly summary count?
I'd like to explain the difference to our CFO before she asks.
## Discussion

### treasury-anna · 2026-11-09
Following. We have three accounts and see the same kind of gap every week.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The weekly summary counts every transaction dated in the previous Monday-to-Monday week across all of the user's accounts, not one account. The count comes from totalsBetween in src/db/repos/transactionRepo.ts, which joins accounts on user_id and groups by currency. The "Operating account" report filters on a single account_id, so the 212 likely includes the other accounts' EUR transactions (140 for Operating plus the rest elsewhere). Nothing is broken; the difference is the scope of the two figures.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Thanks for the detailed report; here is what triage found.

The weekly summary counts every transaction dated in the previous Monday-to-Monday week across all of the user's accounts, not one account. The count comes from totalsBetween in src/db/repos/transactionRepo.ts, which joins accounts on user_id and groups by currency. The "Operating account" report filters on a single account_id, so the 212 likely includes the other accounts' EUR transactions (140 for Operating plus the rest elsewhere). Nothing is broken; the difference is the scope of the two figures.

In short: the weekly summary counts every transaction dated in the previous Monday-to-Monday week across all of the user's accounts, not one account.

This triage rests on the issue as it was filed and on what RepoMind's own reads of the repository returned. If any of it looks wrong, a maintainer can change the label. Nothing in the code has been changed.
